payload.title: Audit cleanup (low priority): Cyclotron
payload.description:
**Problem**
Low-priority findings from the 2026-10-20 audit of the Cyclotron repo.

- [ ] docs/design-journal.md:941 says "as requested by the user"; rewrite neutrally.
- [ ] docs/publication-deployment-contract.md:117 says "Ryan authorized local..." and contains ticket IDs; rewrite as a neutral statement.
- [ ] docs/diagrams/*.json tool receipts contain local /Users/home/Projects/Decision-Flywheel paths; strip or regenerate with relative paths.
- [ ] .agents/skills/run-study references paths to the private Biased-Decisions repo; make generic or document the dependency.
- [ ] README title is 'Cyclotron — Decision Flywheel' with no install command; pyproject.toml package name is decision-flywheel. Align name and add an install command.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md:107 "feat(study): land Ryan's uncommitted study and calibration work"; reword.

**Evidence**
- docs/design-journal.md:941 "explanations attached to development and audit items, as requested by the user."
- docs/publication-deployment-contract.md:117 "... Ryan authorized local".
- docs/diagrams/classifier.browser-check.json, classifier.delivery.json, classifier.finalize-summary.json (and others) contain Decision-Flywheel local paths.
- .agents/skills/run-study/SKILL.md references Biased-Decisions paths.
- README.md:1 "# Cyclotron — Decision Flywheel"; pyproject.toml `name = "decision-flywheel"`.
- CHANGELOG.md:107.

**Fix**
Fix each checklist item; tick them off as they land.

**How to verify**
`git grep -n -e 'Ryan' -e 'as requested by the user' -e '/Users/home' -- docs .agents CHANGELOG.md README.md` returns nothing, and the README has an install command that matches the package name.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
